english.title: Fail to comply with duty to obtain information from third parties about a suspected PSC
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were

(A)_[a company to which Part 21A of the Companies Act 2006 applied and failed]_
(B)_[an officer of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), to which Part 21A of the Companies Act 2006 applied and who was in default by failing]_

to comply with the duty under section 790DA(3) of the Act to give a notice to a third party, namely **(..SPECIFY THIRD PARTY..), knowing or having cause to believe that a person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), was a suspected person with significant control, being under a duty to give the suspected person with significant control a notice under section 790D of the Act but not having the information needed in order to contact that person and knowing or having cause to believe that the third party either knew the identity of the suspected person with significant control or knew the identity of someone likely to have that knowledge
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 790DA(3) and 790F of the Companies Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
